prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE complete flat opaque landscape 16:9 SNS poster for a weekend houseplant market. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Input image 1 is a newly authored planning diagram: reference only for the alternating action-crop organization, whole copy-group turns, readable paragraph area, mature Korean letter anatomy and meaningful spacing. Its neutral figures and gray planes are not the finished scene or final style. Interpret the geometry for a finished photographic poster; no need to preserve exact coordinates. Create real tightly observed repotting photography, not a sketch or clipart.

Whole image: three unequal horizontal photographic bands make an edited sequence of one ordinary repotting activity. The top band extends from a little left of center to the right edge and touches the top edge; the second, closer band enters from the left edge in the middle; the third occupies the lower right to the bottom and right edge. The alternating openings and changing close distance are unmistakable even at thumbnail size. These are three scenes inside one finished poster, not three posters or a comparison sheet. Crisp monochrome editorial photographs, deep stable blacks and controlled midtones, with a restrained ink-blue separation only in photographic shadows. Background reading openings are warm off-white, with dark black-blue clean typesetting. Exact rectangular flat cuts. Rich real soil, fine roots, skin texture and unglazed pot surfaces, slightly coarse photographic tone restricted to imagery. No distressed letters, folded paper, simulated taped edges, arrows or numbered steps.

Scene continuity: the same modest pothos houseplant, with several connected heart-shaped leaves on short connected stems, the same plain unmarked nursery pot and slightly larger plain receiving pot, same bare adult hands and same work surface throughout. No health transformation. Top: tightly crop forearms and hands lifting a soil-bound rootball beside the empty receiving pot, one palm clearly underneath the rootball and the other stabilizing it. Rootball diameter plausibly fits the receiving pot. Middle: a closer view of the same rootball, fine branching roots and crumbly soil, the supporting palm directly in contact underneath, receiving pot rim at the edge. Lower right: the plant seated in soil in that receiving pot, two hands gripping the sides to set it down, base actually contacting the surface. Show coherent wrist-to-hand-to-finger ownership, realistic number of fingers, rootball and pot scale, real contact and support. Crop faces, packages and unrelated tools or props out. Leaves belong to this plant and do not decorate the perimeter.

Reading route and type: upper-left date is the first verbal anchor, prominent semibold clean numerals with a distinctly longer en dash; market, hours and venue form one close left-aligned visit cluster below. The top photograph carries the gaze to the middle-right opening. There the slogan introduces the complete broad paragraph, left-aligned in three meaningful lines with comfortable leading. Use mature medium-weight Korean sans anatomy as in the guide: stable consonant/vowel proportions, open counters, consistent stroke weight, natural word spaces and upright precise baseline. Body must be full reading size, roughly the guide's 42-per-1600-width body proportions, comfortably readable at 720-wide usage, never caption-sized. The explanation's first sentence is line one, its grower's-story clause is line two, and its house-light-and-lifestyle clause is line three. Access and care follow directly under the paragraph on the same middle-right start. The third action crop leads down-left to a modest Korean identity and smaller Latin companion, with invitation and URL directly beneath, all one local finish. Date and identity are moderately larger than the body; no huge title. Clean Latin ampersand, periods, URL slash, hours colons and middle dots; preserve every punctuation kind and meaningful word space. No image texture in type.

Print only the following twelve entries, each exactly once. The following grouping labels are instructions, never printed. Text is verbatim; paragraph wrapping at word boundaries does not change its literal copy.
Upper-left visit, in this order:
2027.06.12–06.13
성수 주말 식물 마켓
토·일 11:00–19:00
성수 온실마당

Middle-right slogan, complete explanation, then access/care:
초록을 고르고, 일상을 가꿉니다.
작은 화분부터 오래 키운 나무까지 만납니다. 재배자의 이야기를 듣고, 우리 집의 빛과 생활에 맞는 식물을 골라보세요.
입장 무료 · 분갈이 시연
식물 구매 시 관리 안내 제공

Lower-left identity and local invitation:
집 안의 작은 숲
LEAVES & LIVING
편하게 들러 천천히 둘러보세요.
leaves.example/market

No other print, logo, QR, watermark, plant tag, written care steps, image lettering or internal labels. One single finished poster, no mockup/frame/wall display/contact sheet. Exclude passive solid, near-solid or split-field headline/date/info templates with subordinate imagery: here the continuous action sequence, alternating substantial photographic crops, changing distance and three copy turns must determine the whole visual system. Exclude clay/toy/complementary packages and big-object/big-title/tiny-footer structures. Preserve complete readable explanation and visit/care/invitation route; use quiet reading openings in an image-led edited sequence.
